acceptanceCriteria: A measured before/after on a >=30k-receipt journal shows the doctor scan bounded, with the measurement retained.
No alert class loses coverage; truncation stays disclosed.
body: Reported in GitHub beamfall/corvint#791: `corvint-tasks doctor` read 4096 receipts with truncated: true and took ~55 s wall (~46 s user CPU) on a ~30k-receipt journal, which is too slow for status-line refresh. Bound the work or reuse the last scan.
title: tasks doctor: scan cost on large journals (~55 s for 4096 receipts on a ~30k-receipt journal) (GH #791 follow-up)
